about: Decisions and issued warnings: who (by), what, when (at, at_epoch in seconds when known to the minute), status, and what each followed. Built by tools/graph-build.mjs from the incident's JSON; every row carries label, source, read and origin. Not a warning service.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Names the low CHARLES (communiqué no. 1); orange warnings to follow, upgrade not ruled out
rows.label: fact

rows.by_name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
rows.decision: Public warning Aviso 21: gusts to 120 km/h, avoid unnecessary travel
rows.label: fact

rows.by_name: ANEPC (Autoridade Nacional de Emergência e Proteção Civil)
rows.decision: Raises special readiness of the civil-protection system; SMS to the population about Wednesday
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Colour of the readiness level not stated on the pages read.

rows.decision: Carris to run, buses followed "minute by minute" from the operations centre (mayor); carris.pt banner "Alerta: perturbações na circulação"
rows.label: fact

rows.decision: Metro to run on Wednesday (announced by the mayor)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Said by the mayor, not read on metrolisboa.pt (no notice found in its HTML at 18:58Z).

rows.decision: Contingency plan for homeless people: Amadora Este, Santa Apolónia, Marquês de Pombal, Moscavide and Interface das Olaias stations open on the nights of 10-11 and 11-12 November
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Read on Metro's own home page banner at 23:33Z (was evidence from a search summary at 22:05Z).

rows.by_name: Fertagus (trains across the 25 de Abril bridge)
rows.decision: Possible disruption on Wednesday announced by Fertagus, Carris and Carris Metropolitana; no suspension announced (as of 16:59Z)
rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: All national coach services suspended Wednesday 10:00 to 23:59
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Jornal de Negócios live 12:39 (company statement) and Jornal Económico 17:47; earlier text "to midnight" came from a search summary and was wrong.

rows.decision: Ferries start at 05:00 as usual on Wednesday; reassessed from 12:00 (the latter from a search summary)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: From a search summary of press reports; the article itself not yet opened.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Red wind warning, Lisbon district, 11 Nov 12:00 to 21:00 (gusts to 120, up to 140 km/h)
rows.label: fact
rows.read_by: incident.meteorologist@web-summit.dinis (CAP via MeteoAlarm), checked by us
rows.note: IPMA's CAP message 2.49.0.0.620.0.PT.261110071840.PO-01-1915, sent_utc 2026-11-10T07:18:40Z, severity Extreme, onset 11 Nov 12:00, expires 21:00; replaces the wind message sent 2026-11-09T13:27:16Z. Via incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/cap.json (incident.meteorologist@, read 2026-11-11T00:23:21Z). First press report: DN live 08:05:24 (Observador 08:34:33). Earlier this edge carried 14:23 (the newsroom's first read) and then 08:05 (the first press report).

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Red warnings for Madeira's south coast and mountains: rain from 21:00 Tuesday to 06:00 Wednesday; wind gusts to 140 km/h from 00:00
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Lusa via Jornal de Negócios live 00:09 (hours); DNOTICIAS listing headline 10 Nov 07:24, "IPMA coloca costa Sul e zonas montanhosas da Madeira sob aviso vermelho". IPMA's send time not read by us (the meteorologist's CAP file covers Lisbon).

rows.decision: Alert situation for all of mainland Portugal, 11 Nov 00:00 to 23:59: (a) schools and non-essential public services close; (b) outdoor events suspended, whatever their nature; (c) no access to high-risk parks; (d) temporary structures secured; (e) no access to shoreline and flood areas; activates coordination centres and civil-protection commissions
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Announced at about 09:17 (minister, ANEPC press conference); the declaration published at 12:10 on portugal.gov.pt. Before 01:00Z on 11 Nov this edge carried only 12:10 (the page time), which put the announcement 3 h late (question raised by incident.conductor@ from incident.media@'s live entries). In force from 00:00 (Lusa, 00:09).

rows.decision: The Interior Minister: "a Web Summit é um local fechado"; if the organisers decide to keep the event, they may
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador live entry 09:30:25 (JSON-LD), questioned by journalists at the press conference. 8 h 23 min later the government recommended suspending Wednesday (17:53).

rows.decision: Madeira schools closed on Wednesday morning, reopening from 13:00
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Announced at a regional press conference by the president of the regional civil protection service (Observador 12:11:17, JSON-LD); DNOTICIAS headline 11:26 "Escolas da Madeira encerradas na manhã de quarta-feira até às 13 horas" (a search summary attributes it to the regional government). Most critical hours given as 21:00 to 06:00 (IPMA Madeira at the same conference).

rows.decision: Schools closed on Wednesday
rows.label: fact

rows.decision: Three cruise calls at Funchal for Wednesday cancelled (Iona, Le Dumont d'Urville, Vasco da Gama)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: APRAM via Observador live 12:33:37 (JSON-LD). The ships cancelled; APRAM reported it.

rows.decision: Organisers: aware of the warnings, assessing with ANEPC and PSP, update to follow; no sign yet of cancelling Wednesday
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Press report of an organiser statement; not found on websummit.com.

rows.decision: Court presidents may close courts fully or partly on Wednesday; urgent acts must go ahead
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: CSM vice-president's despacho, via Lusa (Observador 12:51:24, 14:32:02). National, not Madeira-specific: "Madeira's courts closed" (Wikipedia) NOT established. csm.org.pt answered (01:45Z) with no matching notice on its home page.

rows.by_name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
rows.decision: All Lisbon road tunnels closed from midnight; parks, gardens and cultural facilities too (the mayor, after meeting civil protection)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: "at" is the article time.

rows.by_name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
rows.decision: Mayor: "Tudo indica que a Web Summit não poderá funcionar amanhã"; the decision is the Interior Ministry's and the organisers'
rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: State museums and monuments closed on Wednesday; tickets can be changed or refunded
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 14:08:23 quoting MMP's online message. At 19:21 Observador adds Lisbon's 25 municipal cultural venues (EGEAC) closed.

rows.by_name: Lusoponte (25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges)
rows.decision: 25 de Abril and Vasco da Gama bridges limited to 60 km/h
rows.label: evidence

rows.decision: TAP adjusts operations; passengers with tickets for travel up to 11 Nov may rebook without penalty to flights up to 17 Nov
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 16:09:04. "TAP cancelling 10 Madeira flights" (Wikipedia) is NOT established: Observador 19:47:28 says only that several TAP Funchal flights were affected on Wednesday, from ANA's site.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Rain raised to red, Lisbon district, 11 Nov 12:00 to 18:00 (orange 05:00 to 12:00); sea orange 12:00 to 21:00
rows.label: fact
rows.read_by: incident.meteorologist@web-summit.dinis (CAP via MeteoAlarm), checked by us
rows.note: Red rain first sent at 2026-11-10T16:30:01Z (CAP 2.49.0.0.620.0.PT.261110163001.PO-10-6273), 12:00 to 18:00; superseded by ipma-red-rain-0900. Via incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/cap.json (incident.meteorologist@, read 2026-11-11T00:23:21Z). Earlier this edge carried 17:42 (weather@'s first read).

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Communiqué no. 2: rain, wind and sea agitation, Depressão CHARLES, mainland and Madeira
rows.label: fact

rows.decision: Registries, industrial property and forensic medicine services closed (telework where possible); DGAJ recommends court closures
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Observador 17:43:17, "Na sequência da declaração de situação de alerta".

rows.decision: Government recommends suspending Web Summit on Wednesday; the decision rests with the organisers ("Já emitimos a nossa recomendação de que os trabalhos desse evento possam suspender-se")
rows.label: evidence

rows.by_name: Lisbon airport (ANA, Humberto Delgado) and airlines
rows.decision: ANA: operations at Lisbon, Faro and Madeira airports conditioned on 11 Nov; cancellations expected
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Press report of an ANA statement; the official airport site is behind a bot check.

rows.decision: ANA: operations at Madeira airport conditioned on 11 Nov; cancellations expected
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Same ANA statement as ana-conditioned (Lisbon, Faro, Madeira).

rows.decision: GNR reinforces its operational deployment: 1,100 personnel on standby, Emergency Protection and Relief Unit (UEPS) highlighted, more patrols
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: GNR's own site lists "10-11-2026 Depressão Charles – GNR reforça dispositivo operacional" (read 01:45Z; the article page reset our connection). The figure 1,100 is from Observador's 18:17:26 entry quoting the GNR communiqué.

rows.decision: FlixBus suspends all national links in Portugal on Wednesday 11 Nov
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: "at" is the live-blog entry time.

rows.decision: Day 3 (Thursday 12 Nov): "Web Summit aims to proceed with Day 3 (Thursday, November 12) as planned, following the passing of Storm Charles. [...] provide further updates as soon as confirmed information becomes available."
rows.label: fact
rows.note: "Aims": an intention, not a guarantee. Same organiser page as websummit-wednesday; press (Jornal de Negócios 19:42, RTP 19:46) followed.

rows.decision: Day 2 (Wednesday 11 Nov) will not take place: "Web Summit will of course respect the Government's direction, and accordingly, Day 2 (Wednesday, November 11th) will not take place." Reasons given: tidal flooding, severe disruption to public transport, high winds on external structures; after discussions with the government, ANEPC and PSP.
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Web Summit's own page "Important event update": datePublished 2026-11-10T19:09:00, dateModified 19:25:44 (the page's JSON-LD; Lisbon = UTC). Found first by incident.conductor@ (read 20:58Z); re-read at source by us at 20:59Z. The organisers' email followed at 19:38Z and the press at 19:42Z. We missed the page from 19:09 to 20:58: it is in the blog list (/blog/), not in sitemap.xml, and we watched only the sitemap, the home page and /news/. Lead time: 1 h 16 min after the government's recommendation (17:53), 16 h 51 min before the red warnings start (12:00 Wed). 21:33Z: the blog listing gives Post.modified 20:06:54 (19:58 when incident.dev@ read it); the page's JSON-LD is still 19:25:44 and post.content is unchanged since our 20:59Z read (sha256 e055635213ca, 1060 characters): listing metadata moved, the text did not.

rows.by_name: IPMA (Instituto Português do Mar e da Atmosfera)
rows.decision: Red rain warning for the Lisbon district brought forward to 11 Nov 09:00 to 18:00 (orange 00:00 to 09:00; yellow from 21:24 Tuesday)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: CAP 2.49.0.0.620.0.PT.261110212300.PO-10-6290, sent_utc 2026-11-10T21:23:00Z, severity Extreme, onset 11 Nov 09:00, expires 18:00; replaces 2.49.0.0.620.0.PT.261110163001.PO-10-6273 (sent 16:30:01). The orange before it (PO-10-6288) runs 00:00-09:00. Via incidents/2026-11-10-storm-charles/data/weather/cap.json (incident.meteorologist@, read 2026-11-11T00:23:21Z); IPMA warnings JSON read by us 23:54Z agrees.

rows.by_name: CP (Comboios de Portugal) and Infraestruturas de Portugal
rows.decision: CP suppresses four trains crossing the 25 de Abril bridge in the most critical window (12:00 to 15:00 forecast: heavy rain, strong wind)
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Lusa, quoting a CP statement; Jornal de Negócios live entry 23:10. Not read on cp.pt (JavaScript app).

rows.decision: AEMET special warning in force: "Aviso especial. Lluvias fuertes y persistentes, rachas muy fuertes y temporal marítimo" (Peninsula and Balearics; Canary Islands warnings shown for Wed 11 to Fri 13)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Title read on AEMET's own warnings page at 01:46Z. Its number (38/2026 per Wikipedia), its period (10 to 12 Nov per Wikipedia) and the Canary Islands' wind alert from 18:00 on 10 Nov were NOT read at source (the details are a map and a JavaScript view).

rows.by_name: Lisbon airport (ANA, Humberto Delgado) and airlines
rows.decision: Flight operations on Wednesday
rows.label: fact
rows.note: No readable notice: the official site returns a bot check. Superseded by ana-conditioned (press, 18:04Z).

rows.by_name: Câmara Municipal de Lisboa (mayor, municipal civil protection)
rows.decision: Municipal emergency plan activation and the city's own measures ("Situação de Alerta: medidas excecionais em Lisboa")
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Page title seen in search by weather@; site refuses automated reads (403). A person must read it.

rows.by_name: CP (Comboios de Portugal) and Infraestruturas de Portugal
rows.decision: CP admits constraints on rail services on Wednesday
rows.label: evidence
rows.note: Press summary (Jornal de Negócios live, 19:45 and 21:31 entries); not on cp.pt, a JavaScript app.

rows.by_name: Night Summit (Web Summit's own evening events)
rows.decision: Night Summit on Wednesday (18:00-21:00; Downtown 21:00-00:00, Príncipe Real)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Still listed for Wednesday on the essentials page at 22:05Z, with no notice. The organisers' 19:09 page says only that Day 2 will not take place. Wind is red until 21:00 Wednesday.

rows.decision: Where and when the PITCH semi-final runs after Wednesday's closure
rows.label: fact
rows.note: Nothing on /startups/pitch/ (no schedule there at all), /startups/, /schedule/, the blog list or Bluesky at 22:05Z. Conflict on the original slot: incident.conductor@ has it on Wednesday 17:00 (source not given to us); Tech Times' preview (9 Nov) puts the semi-finals and final on Thursday 12 Nov. If Thursday, the closure may not move it. Where a move would appear: the blog list first (as on 10 Nov), then the schedule page and the app. 22:09Z: /schedule/ embeds only 7 featured sessions, all on 10 Nov, none PITCH: it cannot settle the slot. The full agenda (the app, or the API the schedule page calls) is not readable without a login or is under /api/, which robots.txt disallows. Conflict stays open until a Web Summit page settles it.

rows.by_name: Side events on Wednesday (e.g. Dear Gatekeepers Live, MEO Arena studio; Night Summit)
rows.decision: HYPOTHESIS: side events at the venue follow the organisers' decision; outdoor ones are suspended by measure (b)
rows.label: hypothesis

rows.by_name: Side events on Wednesday (e.g. Dear Gatekeepers Live, MEO Arena studio; Night Summit)
rows.decision: Dear Gatekeepers Live (Wed 10:00, MEO Arena studio): no notice on its page
rows.label: fact
rows.note: The page returns almost no text to our tools (47 characters): a JavaScript app.

rows.decision: Thursday 12 Nov transport after the storm (Metro, Carris, CP, ferries, bridges)
rows.label: fact
rows.note: No operator notice for Thursday found at 22:05Z: metrolisboa.pt and carris.pt (no Thursday notice in HTML), cp.pt (JavaScript app), ttsl.pt, lusoponte.pt (unreachable); a web search found only Wednesday notices. Indirect: tax offices and customs reopen Thursday (Jornal de Negócios, via search).

rows.decision: What happens to Wednesday's talks and speakers, the PITCH semi-final, side events and tickets
rows.label: fact
rows.note: The organisers' page (19:09, modified 19:25) says only "Web Summit will communicate directly with those impacted". Nothing on talks, PITCH, side events or tickets on websummit.com (blog list, home, /startups/pitch/, /night-summit/, /essentials/schedule/), Bluesky, the press or a web search at 20:59Z. 21:33Z: still nothing (blog list: no new post; Bluesky: last post 17:36Z; Jornal de Negócios live to 21:31).

rows.decision: HYPOTHESIS: the organisers suspend or shorten Wednesday
rows.label: hypothesis
rows.note: Confirmed by websummit-wednesday (19:38Z).

rows.decision: HYPOTHESIS: Thursday holds unless storm damage at the venue or transport recovery says otherwise
rows.label: hypothesis
